gloss: clever idea, bright idea, ingenious plan

definitions.gloss: clever idea — a particularly good or ingenious idea or plan, often one that elegantly solves a tricky problem
definitions.explanation: A clever, ingenious, or particularly well-suited idea — often one that resolves a problem that seemed difficult, or that is noticeably more elegant than ordinary proposals. Frequently used in phrases expressing that someone has or has not come up with such an idea.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{妙案|みょうあん}だ。
⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{妙案|みょうあん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Don't you have some clever idea?

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{妙案|みょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: She came up with a clever idea at the meeting.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{妙案|みょうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かば→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ず、⟦{最終的|さいしゅうてき}→最終的：13013_saishuuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{従来|じゅうらい}→従来：12511_juurai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ことにした。
examples.english: No matter how much we thought, no clever idea came to mind, so in the end we decided to use the conventional method.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{妙|みょう}→妙：01766_myou⟧ ('ingenious, marvelous, uncanny') and ⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧ ('plan, idea, proposal').

USAGE:
- Implies a noticeably bright or clever idea, not just any idea — there is a sense of admiration built into the word.
- Commonly appears in set expressions like {妙案|みょうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧ ('a clever idea comes to mind') and {妙案|みょうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ ('I can't come up with a clever idea').
- Slightly literary or formal in feel; in very casual conversation, speakers are more likely to use ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧ or ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {妙案|みょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}いつく: to think up a clever idea
- {妙案|みょうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かぶ→浮かぶ：03916_ukabu⟧: a clever idea comes to mind
- {妙案|みょうあん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to offer/propose a clever idea
- {妙案|みょうあん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no good ideas / to be at a loss

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名案|めいあん}→名案：15591_meian⟧: excellent idea — very close in meaning; ⟦{名案|めいあん}→名案：15591_meian⟧ emphasizes that the idea is outstanding, while {妙案|みょうあん} emphasizes cleverness or ingenuity.
- {良案|りょうあん}: good idea, good plan — somewhat more formal and less common; emphasizes soundness rather than cleverness.
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{考|かんが}え→考え：00855_kangae⟧: good idea — the everyday, conversational equivalent.
- ⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧: idea — a loanword, neutral in register; common in everyday speech.
